I'm actually going to be picking one up very soon, but here are the things that I do know about some of the boxes out there:

HCigar VT200: Has a lot of issues, namely with the screen. I'm not sure if they've acknowledged these issues, but I would stay away from them for the time being.

Vaporshark DNA 200 box: This is the only one that has a zip-charging function, which is super nice, but VS's site has had TONS of security issues. I wouldn't buy from them, and if you really want one try to find a reseller.

Hobo-X: These come in a variety of styles, and I believe the breakdown is the following:

  • Aluminum Box: $200

  • Hybrid Box: $350

  • Stabilized Wood: $390

Apparently they're much smaller than people might initially think, and I may pick up an aluminum one because they're going to be distributed fairly widely, I believe.

Steam Monkey HFO 200: The V1 may have turned a lot of people off just with button placement, but they're updating to a new version that has more usual button placements. They're working on having replaceable panels, as well. This one is at the top of my list because Lance and Walter are way cool guys.

Lavabox 200: I haven't heard anything about this, but back in the long long ago, Volcano Ecigs didn't have like a super great reputation or antying. The aesthetics might turn people off of them, but I don't think it will be bad.

I would expect to spend at least $200 on any of the boxes, but given the capabilities of the DNA 200 board, I don't have a problem with that.

The only thing I don't know about with a lot of these is durability. My XvoStick is definitely my out and about mod, since it's essentially indestructible. I may pick up an aluminum Hobo-X later on as well so I can have one of these boxes to take around town with me.
